answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
